hooks.command: INPUT=$(cat); DIR=$(echo "$INPUT" | jq -r '.cwd // "."' | xargs basename); MSG=$(echo "$INPUT" | jq -r '.message // "Claude needs your input"'); CC_TITLE="Claude · $DIR" CC_MSG="$MSG" osascript -e 'display notification (system attribute "CC_MSG") with title (system attribute "CC_TITLE") sound name "Glass"'
